title: GET /api/reference serves the product reference as JSON
when: Calls the API for a product with its own kinds.
then: Expects 200 with its reference as JSON.

title: Writes through the store and answers with the rows it changed
when: Posts a write that sets a use case's goal and adds a requirement to the dev API plugin over a copy of a product.
then: Expects 200 with `ok` true, the tables `uc_requirement` and `use_case`, the use case's row before and after with its goal changed to `A writer keeps a thought.`, and the new requirement `EX-NOTE-UC01-R01` with no row before.

title: Answers a refused write with every reason and changes nothing
when: Posts a write that sets a use case's goal and adds a requirement under the missing use case `EX-NOTE-UC09`.
then: Expects 422 with `ok` false, at least one problem, an error naming `EX-NOTE-UC09`, and `data/use_case.jsonl` unchanged.

title: Refuses a write from another site, one not sent as JSON, and one that is not a list of commands
when: Posts to `/api/write` from another origin, as plain text, with a body that is not JSON, with an empty list, an unknown op and an add with no row, with GET, and with a body over 1 MB.
then: Expects 403 for the other origin, 415 for plain text, 400 for the body that is not JSON, the empty list, the unknown op and the add with no row, 405 for GET and 413 for the large body.

title: POST /api/write goes to the folder of the product its commands name
when: Posts writes naming a listed product's records, then records of both products.
then: Expects the first written to the listed product's data folder only, and the second answered 422 with no file changed.

title: GET /api/history lists the commits that changed a record's rows, newest first, with the columns each changed and the uncommitted changes
when: Against a temporary git repo of the good fixture with two commits that change the use case's row, one that changes another file, and a change not committed.
then: Expects 200 with the use case's data files (`use_case.jsonl`, `use_case_actor.jsonl`, `follows.jsonl`); a first page of `HISTORY_PAGE` commits, newest first, with more to come, the newest by `Owner` changing only the goal; `Say more about UC01` changing the title and goal, `Give UC01 its pattern` adding a `follows` row, and no `Describe the pattern`, which changed only other rows; an older page ending at `Add the example product` with every column added; and the uncommitted goal change and added actor row.

title: GET /api/history answers 404 for an unknown record and 400 without an ID
when: Asks `GET /api/history` in a git repository for an ID no record has, for an empty ID and with a negative `skip`, then for a use case in a folder outside any git repository.
then: Expects 404 with no-record for an ID no record has, 400 without an ID, and no-repo with a calm message for a folder outside any git repository.

title: GET /api/history says calmly when the folder is not in a git repository
when: Asks `GET /api/history` for a use case in a folder outside git, and in a repository for the path `../data/use_case.jsonl` as the ID.
then: Expects the use case's data file `data/use_case.jsonl` found from the data by its ID outside git, and 400 or 404 for the path `../data/use_case.jsonl` as the ID.

title: GET /api/history changes nothing in the repo
when: Asks for a record's history, and an older page of it, against a temporary repo with a change not committed.
then: Expects the repo's status and its config the same before and after.

title: A record's history is read from git's log of its rows: -G by its first column, log records and diffs parsed
when: Searches a repo's log by a record's first column, and parses log records and a diff with other records' rows and lines that are not rows.
then: Expects only the commits of the record's rows, each log record's fields, and only the record's changed rows.

title: GET /api/baseline answers a product's rows at the last commit, the branch's start and a noted commit, and says calmly when there is no repo or commit
when: Against a temporary git repo of the good fixture on a branch off main with a commit of its own and a change not committed, and a folder outside any repo.
then: Expects since=commit to give the last commit's rows (`Shorter`, title `Write a short note`); since=branch the rows where the branch left `main` (`Add the example product`, title `Write a note`); a noted hash its rows; the diff against the last commit to be the uncommitted title change to `Write a very short note`; no-repo outside a repo, no-commit for an unknown hash, 400 for a bad since or no product, and 404 for an unknown product.

title: Serves the typed data from the data folder, with the schema, and the folder it reads
when: Asks the dev API plugin for GET /api/spec over a product.
then: Expects 200, not cached, with the schema description, the data folder and every stored table's rows.

title: Answers 500 with the reason when the engine cannot be loaded
when: Asks for GET /api/spec with an engine that fails to load.
then: Expects 500 with the error `The engine could not be loaded: Cannot find module @duckdb/node-api`, and paths outside the API passed on.

title: The app reads GET /api/spec's typed rows into its index: each record with its parent, product, domain, file and line, links both ways, parts under their owner
when: Indexes workspaces as GET /api/spec serves them, a product's own kinds among them.
then: Expects a record per row with its one parent and its scope, a kind with no owner placed by its ID, rows kept typed with their file and line, links read both ways, parts in key order under their owner, and a product's own kind after Lathe's.

title: GET /api/spec serves each product folder's rows apart under one schema
when: Calls GET /api/spec for a workspace of two products, then for one whose two folders hold the same product ID.
then: Expects 200 with both sources, the workspace's first, one schema with each product's own kinds, and each product's problems and coverage; then 500 naming the product and both folders.

title: Opens an uncached event stream that starts connected
when: Asks a running `lathe serve` for GET /api/events.
then: Expects 200, a `text/event-stream` with `no-cache`, and a first `: connected` comment; the `spec:changed` event after a data file changes is LA-PLT-UC02-R04-T01's.
